# Third-party inventory

The Go dependencies and their versions are recorded in [go.mod](../go.mod) and
[go.sum](../go.sum). [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES) lists their
licenses. Release archives include license and notice files collected from
the module dependencies under `third_party/dependency-licenses/`.

The project is distributed under [Apache-2.0](../LICENSE).
